saints.name: Sts. Sixtus II and Companions
saints.title: Pope and Martyrs
saints.shortBlurb: A pope of Rome martyred with his deacons in the catacombs during the persecution of Valerian…
biography: Sixtus II was elected Bishop of Rome in 257, in the midst of the persecution unleashed by the Emperor Valerian, whose edict of 258 commanded the immediate execution of bishops, priests, and deacons. On 6 August 258, while celebrating the sacred mysteries in the cemetery of Praetextatus, Sixtus was seized and beheaded together with several of his deacons.

His archdeacon Lawrence was put to death four days later, and Sixtus was numbered at once among the most honored of the Roman martyrs, his name entered into the Canon of the Mass. He is remembered as a shepherd who died at the altar with his ministers around him.
saints.knownFor: Dying as a martyr at the altar during Valerian's persecution.
